desc: Establish that values greater than `threshold` are isolated and that valid LCM edges correspond exactly to pairs sharing a multiple no greater than `threshold`.
Implement DSU indexed by values `1..threshold` and sieve multiples while storing a representative divisor per multiple.
Count roots only for input values at most `threshold`, then add the number of input values greater than `threshold`.
Verify the implementation against both examples and boundary cases: all values above threshold, `1` present, and no valid edges.
